heroSummary: Federal Way Public Schools begins Tuesday, September 2, 2025. Kindergarten Connection conferences and half days run September 2–9, regular Friday early releases begin September 19, and the scheduled last day is Tuesday, June 16, with early dismissal.
calendarNotes: FWPS uses several kinds of shortened or non-school days that should not be treated as interchangeable. Selected Friday early releases follow the recurring district pattern, while November 26 and June 16 use separate early-dismissal schedules. Kindergarten Connection combines conferences with half days during the opening week. Scholar-Led Conference dates are full no-school days. January 5 is a two-hour late start after Winter Break. Seniors finish one week before the districtwide last day. May 22 and June 17 remain no-school days unless activated as snow make-up dates.

customSections.content: FWPS uses four different schedule changes: selected-Friday early releases, Kindergarten Connection half days, a two-hour late start after Winter Break, and separate early-dismissal days before Thanksgiving and at year end.

customSections.label: Snow Make-Up Dates Are Conditional
customSections.content: May 22 and June 17 are marked as snow make-up days and no-school days unless needed. June 17 falls immediately after the scheduled last day, so an activation could extend the student year.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Federal Way Public Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The official FWPS calendar lists Tuesday, September 2, 2025, as the first day of school. Kindergarten Connection conferences and half days run September 2–9.

calendarFaqs.q: When is FWPS Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. School resumes Monday, January 5, with a two-hour late start.

calendarFaqs.q: When is FWPS Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs April 6–10, 2026. Scholar-Led Conferences are separate no-school days on April 2–3, immediately before the weekend leading into break.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of FWPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day is Tuesday, June 16, 2026, with early dismissal. June 17 is a snow make-up day and remains a no-school day unless FWPS activates it.

calendarFaqs.q: Are all FWPS Friday early releases included in the calendar file?
calendarFaqs.a: The page lists every selected Friday in the schedule guide. The downloadable calendar emphasizes major districtwide dates and marks when the recurring pattern begins; confirm exact release times with the school.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed against the official FWPS calendar page and the district's 2025–26 English school calendar PDF.
sourceReviewDetails: The PDF's color key was checked visually to distinguish early release, early dismissal, conferences, professional-development closures, seniors' last day, and conditional snow make-up dates.
Selected Friday releases are listed in a dedicated schedule table so families can see the exceptions to the recurring pattern.
School bell times, graduation details, preschool schedules, and closure announcements remain school- or district-controlled information.
